import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        long mod = (long) m;
        long[] dp = new long[n + 3];
        long[] sdp = new long[n + 3];
        
        dp[n] = 1;
        sdp[n] = 1;
        
        // sdp[n+1] is 0 by default
        // The Python code initializes sdp[n]=1 and then iterates from n-1 down to 1.
        // sdp[x] = sdp[x+1] + dp[x]
        // Note: sdp[n+1] is 0, so sdp[n] = 0 + dp[n] = 1.
        
        for (int x = n - 1; x >= 1; x--) {
            long currentDp = sdp[x + 1];
            currentDp %= mod;
            
            int z = 2;
            while (x * z <= n) {
                int l = x * z;
                int r = (x + 1) * z - 1;
                if (r > n) r = n;
                
                long rangeSum = (sdp[l] - sdp[r + 1]) % mod;
                currentDp = (currentDp + rangeSum) % mod;
                z++;
            }
            
            dp[x] = (currentDp + mod) % mod;
            sdp[x] = (sdp[x + 1] + dp[x]) % mod;
        }
        
        System.out.println(dp[1] % mod);
    }
}
